name: Lillyjean
description: How the token files combine. Foundation first, then one theme. `pnpm tokens:build` resolves the light and dark contexts and writes src/app/tokens.css.

foundation.description: Palette, type, shape, space, motion and gradients; the same in every theme.

theme.description: Colour theme. Light is the designed default (:root); dark is opt-in via data-theme="dark" on <html>.
